description: Aggregated pass-rate and run-count analytics per Maestro flow file over a lookback window. Use to identify flaky flows (low pass_rate but many passed_runs) vs. genuinely broken flows. Returns flow_name, file_name, pass_rate, passed_runs, failed_runs, total_runs, avg_duration, last_run_at, tags, daily_data per flow.
